_meta.source_of_truth: Live Notion data-source schemas, fetched 2026-08-21/24 via MCP, reconciled against 01_Sector/SECTOR_NOTION_SCHEMA.md
_meta.authority: The LIVE schema is authoritative for what exists. SECTOR_NOTION_SCHEMA.md is authoritative for why a field exists. Where they disagree, both are recorded and the divergence is flagged in `_divergences`. Neither is silently preferred.
_meta.row_counts: TWO KINDS, never blurred. `row_count_verified` + `verified_date` = a live SELECT COUNT(*) actually ran. `row_count_claimed` = the repository's own population records (SECTOR_OS.md §15 changelogs, FIELD_POPULATION_PLAN.md, HOSPITALITY_PLUGIN.md) — a repo claim, not a measurement.
_meta.row_counts_2026_08_24_update: The query API IS available on this plan, contrary to the Gate 0 note — it is metered, not absent. Six databases were verified before the workspace quota was exhausted: DB1, DB2, DB3, DB6, DB9, DB10. THREE OF THE SIX WERE WRONG (DB6 0→1, DB9 0→4, DB10 52→57), all in the same direction: the repo under-recorded work that had actually been done. The remaining ten are still unverified claims and are labelled as such. Verify the rest when quota resets rather than trusting the claim.

field_class.direct: direct-intelligence — researched from an authoritative external source
field_class.derived: derived-intelligence — computed from other records; never researched directly
field_class.state: operational-state — the system's own lifecycle/status, set by transition logic
field_class.relation: relationship — a pointer to another canonical entity
field_class.strategic: strategic-decision — an Arika judgement, not a market fact
field_class.meta: metadata — provenance, confidence, freshness, versioning, audit
field_class.vocab: controlled-vocabulary — values constrained to an approved option set

disposition.green: fillable now — research or transcription; cite the source, set Confidence to match
disposition.yellow: needs owner — a decision only the owner can make; not a research task
disposition.red: needs scraping — gated on API key + cost governance + Legal + Approval-Matrix row
disposition.black: never fill / template — populated only from a connected client system
